PHYSICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.

17. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.

19. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

20. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
22. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Dynamics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Circular motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Floating and Sinking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Quantity of Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Thin lenses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Photoelectric effect and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic induction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Mains electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
